meta_title: JEH Plumbing & Heating | Emergency Plumber Bolton
meta_description: JEH Plumbing and Heating in Bolton. Emergency plumbing, boiler repairs, and heating installations. Fast response times, Gas Safe registered. Call now.
hero_subhead: Burst pipe at 2am? We're there in under an hour, any day of the week. Fast, reliable, fair prices.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Heating Services Across Bolton
services_subhead: From burst pipes and boiler breakdowns to full heating system installations, we handle every job with speed and expertise.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaks, and blockages fixed fast, day or night. We carry full parts stock and aim to resolve most issues in one visit.

services.title: Boiler Repairs & Servicing
services.desc: Annual services keep your boiler efficient and safe. Emergency repairs available 24/7 — most faults diagnosed and fixed same day.

services.title: Boiler Installation
services.desc: New boiler fitted with minimum disruption. We'll advise on the right model for your home, handle all the pipework, and leave you with a 10-year parts warranty.

services.title: Heating System Installation
services.desc: Full central heating systems designed and installed to match your home's layout. Includes radiators, thermostats, and commissioning.

services.title: Radiator Repairs & Bleeding
services.desc: Cold radiators, leaks, and noisy systems sorted quickly. We'll diagnose the fault and fix it, or replace the unit if needed.

services.title: Bathroom & Kitchen Plumbing
services.desc: Tap replacements, pipe runs, and leak repairs in wet rooms. We work neatly and always leave the area clean.

about_pullquote: I started this business because I was tired of seeing neighbours ripped off by cowboys.
about_para_1: JEH Plumbing and Heating was founded over a decade ago with one simple aim: to provide honest, fast plumbing and heating repairs to homes across Bolton and Horwich. We're Gas Safe registered and carry all the tools and parts we need on the van — which means your emergency gets fixed first time, not three visits later.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on showing up on time, explaining what needs doing without the jargon, and charging fairly. Most of our work comes from repeat customers and their referrals. When a pipe bursts at midnight or your boiler dies in winter, you need someone you can trust. That's us.
reviews_heading: What Bolton Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Pipe burst on Christmas Eve at half nine at night. Thought we were done for, but Jeh answered the phone straight away, came out within 45 minutes, and fixed it properly. Wouldn't have known what to do without him. Top bloke.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Boiler completely gave up in January. Called Monday morning, they were here by evening, replaced the whole thing Tuesday. Professional job, explained everything, and the price was reasonable. Very happy.
reviews.author: Helen P.

reviews.text: Had a radiator leaking underneath. Was dreading a big bill, but turned out to be a loose valve. Fixed in ten minutes, no call-out charge, no faffing about. Will definitely use again if needed.
reviews.author: David M.
